description.en: Moves loose files from the desktop (or another folder) into category folders. Every run is journaled and can be undone.
description.zh-CN: 把桌面（或其他文件夹）上散落的文件按类别收进文件夹。每次都有记录，可以一键撤销。

description.en: How many items are waiting and whether the last run can be undone.
description.zh-CN: 还有多少散落文件，上一次能否撤销。

description.en: List what would move where, without moving anything.
description.zh-CN: 列出会被移到哪里，不做任何改动。

description.en: Move the loose files into category folders.
description.zh-CN: 把散落文件收进分类文件夹。

description.en: Put the files from the most recent run back where they were.
description.zh-CN: 把最近一次收纳的文件放回原处。

description.en: Open the folder the files were filed into.
description.zh-CN: 打开收纳文件所在的文件夹。

source.description: desktop, downloads, documents, or a folder inside your home folder

library.description: where the category folders go; empty means Documents/Desktop Archive (桌面收纳 in Chinese)

preset.description: language of the category folder names; empty follows the user's language

group_by_month.description: file into Category/2026-10 instead of Category

include_folders.description: also move loose folders (off by default: folders are often live projects)

min_age_seconds.description: leave files changed in the last N seconds alone (downloads in progress)
